ColecoVision is a 1982 second generation home video-game console.
First released in North America in August 1982 and discontinued in 1985.
Made by Coleco.
About 2 million units were sold.
It followed the Coleco Telstar series and was succeeded by the Coleco Adam.
Processors include the Zilog Z80.
